title: Vivian Maier's street photographs
summary: Working as a nanny, Vivian Maier took more than 150,000 photographs of street life, most never printed in her lifetime.
why: A major body of 20th-century street photography.

unsung.contribution: Took over 150,000 street photographs, chiefly of Chicago and New York.
unsung.recognition: Her photographs were unknown and unpublished in her lifetime; they surfaced at a 2007 storage auction and were recognised after her death.
